_comment: Single source of truth for changeable facts. Both pace-report-generate and pace-report-finalize read this file (finalize via ../pace-report-generate/config.json). Do not duplicate any of these values in prose or code.
_parent_folder_comment: This is the flat 'Pace Reports' folder for the current year. When the team rolls to a new year's folder, update parent_folder_id, deprecated_folder_id, and drive_local_folder together.
team_mrv_post_message: It's that time of the week! Please fill out your section of the Pace Report
_google_token_comment: Reused from the basco-intake automation, same pattern as eac-inventory-monitor's config. Has drive+spreadsheets+gmail.modify scopes. Used by generate_pace_report.py to move file bytes program-to-program instead of through the model's own output, added 2026-09-17 after two straight scheduled runs (09-09, 09-16) died at the 900s watchdog trying to retype a base64-encoded xlsx through a Bash command.
_autonomous_send_comment: Max explicitly designed and requested this full autonomous cycle (2026-08-27): post to #team-mrv, detect completion, move last week's file to Deprecated, post to #team-strategery -- all without a per-run confirmation. This is a standing, narrow exception scoped to exactly this automation, mirroring charm-350-credit-report's carve-out.
